title: Publish Bundle (v0)
description: The folder/file structure shipped from the tracker to the app. A bundle is delivered as a ZIP whose root contains these files and folders. The app extracts and consumes.

bundle_version.description: The schema version this bundle conforms to. Example: 'v0', 'v1.2'.

tour_id.description: Stable identifier for the tour. Example: 'year-of-gaudi'.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the bundle was generated.

tracker_commit.description: Short git SHA of the tracker repo at publish time, for traceability.

x-directory-layout.comment: Not validated by JSON Schema directly; this is the agreed-on file layout. The validator on each side checks paths exist + each JSON conforms to its referenced schema.

root.bundle.json: Self-describing manifest at the bundle root (matches this schema).
root.bibliography.json: Array of bibliography entries. Matches bibliography.schema.json.
root.characters.json: Array of characters. Matches characters.schema.json. App may ignore for v0 launch.

locales/.en.json: English strings, keyed by content ID. Matches locale.schema.json.
locales/.ca.json: Catalan strings. Same keys as en.json.
locales/.es.json: Spanish strings. Same keys as en.json.

images/.character-<id>.jpg: Character portraits, optional; deferred for v0 app launch.
